claims.explanation: The correct first case from |x-1|=|x-2| is x-1=x-2, not x-1=2-x. In fact x-1=2-x is the same as the second listed case x-1=-(x-2), so the two supposed cases are not distinct.
Solving the written first equation x-1=2-x gives 2x=3, so x=3/2, not -1. If the intended first case were x-1=x-2, it would have no solution.
Solving x-1=-(x-2) gives x-1=-x+2, so 2x=3 and x=3/2, not 3/4.
